steps.subject: your design partners, told to an investor
steps.body:
Hi Maya,

Tidewell opened its private beta on 29 September, and your note on the first ten design partners ends on the question of turning them into a story an investor can follow.

That question is the one we work on with founders at swanbase, a Paris accelerator for first-time founders. We wrote a one-page checklist of what investors ask about early users. Want me to send it before your pre-seed round?

{{sender_first_name}}

Maya, I will stop writing here and wish the beta a good second wave. If a year-round program becomes useful for Tidewell later, reply to this thread.

{{sender_first_name}}

p002.hook: I read the summary of your Hardware Night Berlin talk on the Ferncast soil sensor that failed in its first week on three farms, and how you rebuilt the casing before asking anyone to pay.
